name: Ganzhou Yihao New Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: Ganzhou Yihao New Materials Co., Ltd., established in 2003 and headquartered in Ganzhou, China, specializes in the research, development, production, and distribution of electrolytic copper foils and electronic components across China. The company's product portfolio includes copper foils specifically designed for electronic circuits, alongside aluminum-based copper-clad laminates and various circuit boards. These materials primarily serve as essential conductors, enabling the interconnection of different electronic parts within numerous sectors, such as communication, computing, consumer electronics, and the automotive industry.
